en.title: Counting 2×2 Submatrices by Number of Black Cells
en.description:
Given the coordinates of all black cells in a rows×cols grid. Classify each 2×2 submatrix by the number of black cells it contains, 0..4, count each class, and return the five counts. Coordinates start from 0 and contain no duplicates.

The statement is explicit; this site adds the coordinate ranges, the distinctness of black cells, and the input protocol.

Source: https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/koddi#4-count-2x2-submatrices-by-black-cell-count (fixed statement fingerprint 48fdfc5f9bc2a2300bd5ec8a9550061d26633407e3f91b51a20f2ba5973a2ff8). The input/output protocol and bounds added by this site follow the statement and are not claimed to be the original site's rules.
en.input: The first line contains rows cols k (1≤rows,cols≤10^9, 0≤k≤min(rows×cols,200000)); the next k lines give the 0-based row col of each black cell.
en.output: Output 5 integers: the numbers of windows containing 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 black cells, in that order.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: Each black cell belongs to at most four 2×2 windows, so only accumulate the windows touched by black cells; every other window has zero black cells.
